title: Weave a sweetgrass basket in Charleston
description: Sit with a Charleston basket maker and learn how to coil and sew sweetgrass into a small basket. As your hands work, hear how this craft has been passed through generations of Gullah Geechee families. The pace is patient, and every shape shows the decisions of the person making it.
teaser: Learn a coastal craft directly from a basket maker.
goodToKnow: Winter sessions need confirming; request a seated beginner format.
whyItMightDelightYou: A lesson makes the skill and family knowledge behind each finished basket easier to recognize.
